## Step 36: request internal states

**What the last result showed.**
- The factual CSV lists every reading with its hour, observed value, predicted mean and bin NLL. Readings in the same bundle (same hour) are listed together.
- Bundles are hourly: readings on the hour, drugs at +5 minutes. So each drug bundle is separate from the measurement bundles.

**What I will do next.** Request the model's internal state after every bundle (out, the 4 h slots, z posterior mean) for the same 100 tuning stays. With these I can:
1. check whether I can rebuild parts of the model locally (heads first, then the step update), since states let me verify computations exactly;
2. see how dose variation moves the state at drug bundles.

**What would count as evidence.** If my local head implementation, fed these states, reproduces the factual predicted means, the heads are understood. I can then decide whether to rebuild the full step update.
